Fauna and Flora Protection (Amendment)
39
Act, No.22 of 2009
Section  67D  of  the  principal  enactment  is  hereby

column1: amended by the substitution for the words “Chapter XII of
the Criminal Procedure Code” of the words “Chapter XI of
the Criminal Procedure Code Act, No. 15 of 1979”.

column2: Section  67F  of  the  principal  enactment  is  hereby

column1: repealed and the following section substituted therefor:—

column2: 67F. (1) any person who is in unlawful and
unauthorized  possession  of  any  State  land  to
which,  the  provisions  of  this  Ordinance  are
applicable shall be liable to an ejectment and
the  provisions  of  State  Lands  (Recovery  of
Possession) Act, No. 7 of 1979 shall  mutatis
mutandis apply, of every such ejectment.
(2)  Any  reference  in  the  said  Act  to  a
Competent Authority shall be considered as a
reference to the Wildlife Ranger of the area in
which such State land is situated.
(3)  Any  proceedings  instituted  under  the
said Act for the recovery of possession of State
land shall be concluded within one year from

the 
date 
of 
commencement 
of 
such
proceedings.”.
